contact.mapQuery: Hixon Insurance Agency, 108 W Spring Grove Ave, North Augusta, SC 29841

hero.title: Insurance from *neighbors you know*
hero.lede: A locally owned, independent agency in North Augusta. We represent several carriers, so we can shop home, auto, business and life coverage to fit you, and help when it’s time to file a claim.

items.title: Home
items.text: Your home is your largest investment, and it should be protected in the event of loss.

items.title: Auto
items.text: Coverage tailored to the vehicles you count on every day.

items.title: Commercial
items.text: A package of insurance built for your business, so you know you’re covered.

items.title: Life
items.text: Single, married with kids, empty nesters, retired or self-employed: we help you choose.

sections.title: Why *independent* matters
sections.intro: Because we represent several insurance carriers, we can compare policies for you instead of selling just one company’s.

columns.title: What you get
items: Policies customized and managed for you
One local agency for home, auto, business and life
Help with claims when you need it

columns.title: Hixon Realty Company
items: Real estate from the same family business

items.text: When I filed a claim after the hurricane, they handled everything quickly and professionally. I have peace of mind knowing my home is protected by a team that truly cares.
A great group of people who are interested in serving you, the customer. They are easy to contact by phone or electronically, very knowledgeable, and always helpful.

items.title: Tell us what you need
items.text: Call (803) 279-8855 or send the form below with what you’d like to insure.

items.title: We compare carriers
items.text: We shop the companies we represent for coverage that fits and a fair price.

items.title: Choose with confidence
items.text: We walk you through the options, then set up and manage your policy.

items.a: We represent several insurance carriers rather than one, so we can compare coverage and price for you.

items.q: Can you help with a claim?
items.a: Yes. Call us and we’ll help you through it with your carrier.

items.q: Are you open on Wednesday afternoons?
items.a: The office closes at 1 pm on Wednesdays. Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday we’re open 9 to 5:30.

items.q: Do you also sell real estate?
items.a: Yes. Hixon Realty Company is part of the same family business; ask us about current listings.

sections.title: Let’s review your coverage
sections.text: Call, or stop by the office on West Spring Grove Avenue.
